diagram_candidates.rationale: The theorem characterizes identifiability by receiver coverage and splitting every nonroot internal vertex. A small labeled tree can make the combinatorial design condition and shared-path probability formulas easier to scan.
labels_maps_relations_to_draw_or_check: Draw a root o and a nonroot internal vertex v with incoming edge e0 and at least two child subtrees; label edge parameters p_e in (0,1).
Show a probe design C_d containing leaves r and s in distinct child subtrees of v.
Mark paths P(o,r), P(o,s); label q_v as the product on P(o,v), m_r=q_v a_r, m_s=q_v a_s, and m_rs=q_v a_r a_s.
Indicate split at v means one C_d intersects two distinct child subtrees; coverage means every leaf belongs to some C_d.
Check that no probe is shown observing edges outside its listed receiver paths.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional source-supported visual aid; no mathematical or rendering defect is present.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The result bounds solution support by intrinsic metric neighborhoods growing at unit speed and gives a boundary collar after forcing starts. A schematic could make the support regions and the two-boundary-trip threshold easier to scan.
labels_maps_relations_to_draw_or_check: Show initial support K at t=0 and region d_g(x,K)≤t for part (i).
Show boundary forcing onset s0 and collar d_g(x,∂M)≤t−s0 for part (ii).
For part (iii), mark Q with d_g(Q,∂M)>T/2 and show forward/backward boundary influence regions failing to meet Q over [0,T].
Label distances as intrinsic d_g and the picture schematic for a general manifold; do not imply exact Euclidean propagation geometry.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional editorial aid; the inclusions and threshold are explicit in the source. No mathematical or rendering defect is present.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition identifies two orientations over each point, the projection to M, and an involution exchanging sheets. A local picture could make the covering structure concrete.
labels_maps_relations_to_draw_or_check: Draw a base chart U and two local sheets +(o_phi(x)) and −(o_phi(x)) over each x in U.
Draw pi from both sheets to U and tau(x,o_x)=(x,−o_x) exchanging sheets while fixing the base point.
On chart overlaps annotate sheet change by sign det D(psi∘phi^{-1}), locally constant; preserve boundary half-space charts.
Avoid implying the global cover is disconnected or globally trivial.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional editorial aid; the source states the two local sheets, projection, overlap sign, and involution. No mathematical or rendering defect is present.

existing_diagrams.review: The upper row shows X --F→ Y --G→ Z with curved composite A=G∘F. The lower row maps data from Z left through R^G_alpha to Y and then left through R^F_gamma to X, consistent with the source instruction to read that row right-to-left. The diagram records domains and order, omits parameter-rule dependence, and is not used in any proof.
